Purpose: Explicit evidence criteria for the Presales and TenantToTenantMigration profiles. Each criterion states which profile owns it, the workloads it covers, whether it is required, the assessment stage it serves, where its evidence comes from, when it applies, what happens when evidence is missing, and whether it affects readiness, planning, or reference only. The assessment builds the MigrationCriteriaRegister from these entries.

Phase.Meaning: The assessment activity the criterion serves. These are not engagement milestones; milestones, waves, and cutover dates are engagement inputs.

Coverage.Meaning: Unsupported means no collector in this repository gathers the evidence; it must come from the customer or a vendor.

Criteria.Criterion: Mailbox inventory for scope and license units
Criteria.Meaning: Mailbox objects that drive migration scope and license units
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the mailbox objects in migration scope
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Mailbox scope and license units cannot be estimated.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed Exchange mailbox collection

Criteria.Meaning: Primary, archive, and deleted-item sizes per mailbox
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Select the mailbox migration licensing approach
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Mailbox data volume and license blocks cannot be sized.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: Mailbox statistics for every in-scope mailbox

Criteria.Meaning: Whether the tenant synchronizes identities from an on-premises directory
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Identity design: source of authority and target account provisioning
Criteria.BlockerImpact: The identity design and its effort cannot be scoped without knowing whether identities are synchronized.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A successful tenant overview and directory synchronization collection, or customer confirmation of the identity model

Criteria.Meaning: Whether Exchange hybrid or coexistence configuration exists
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the wave, coexistence, forwarding, and routing approach
Criteria.BlockerImpact: The coexistence design is a planning decision; scope can be estimated without it.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed Exchange hybrid collection with every probe answered, or customer confirmation

Criteria.Meaning: Mailbox-level hold indicators and organization-wide retention policies
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm legal, hold, retention, eDiscovery, and records requirements
Criteria.BlockerImpact: The preservation approach, and whether held mailboxes can move with the chosen method, cannot be decided.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: Mailbox hold fields for every mailbox and the Purview retention policy inventory

Criteria.Meaning: Domains that must be moved, retained, or retired
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Approve domain disposition, DNS ownership, release order, and dependencies
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Domain sequencing cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed domain collection

Criteria.Criterion: SharePoint and OneDrive storage for sizing
Criteria.Meaning: Site counts and storage totals that drive collaboration migration effort
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the collaboration migration scope and tool
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Collaboration data volume and effort cannot be sized.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed SharePoint and OneDrive collection

Criteria.Meaning: Teams and their channel types
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm Teams, group, and group-connected site mappings
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Teams configuration effort cannot be estimated precisely.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed Teams inventory

Criteria.Meaning: Enterprise applications and their single sign-on mode
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Application re-integration effort cannot be estimated.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed authentication and SSO collection

Criteria.Meaning: Licenses and service plans in use in the source tenant
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm destination provisioning, licenses, capacity, and consent
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Destination license needs cannot be compared with the source.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed license SKU collection

Criteria.Population: Entra registered, joined, and hybrid joined devices
Criteria.Meaning: Devices known to Microsoft Entra ID
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Endpoint effort is estimated without device counts.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed device collection, or a customer device count

Criteria.Meaning: Which server runs synchronization and whether a staging server exists
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the synchronization server, staging server, and operating owner
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Account provisioning cannot be scheduled without a confirmed synchronization host.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: Customer confirmation from the identity owner

Criteria.Criterion: Mailbox inventory with cutover routing attributes
Criteria.Meaning: Mailbox objects with routing aliases, X500, and GUIDs for target preparation
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Approve source-to-target UPN, SMTP, alias, anchor, and conflict mappings
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Target mail objects cannot be prepared.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed Exchange mailbox collection

Criteria.Meaning: Full Access, Send As, Send on Behalf, and calendar folder permissions to reapply
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Delegate reapplication cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A TenantToTenantMigration run alone; combining it with another profile turns delegate collection off

Criteria.Meaning: Whether the tenant synchronizes identities from an on-premises directory
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Identity design: source of authority and target account provisioning
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Source of authority for migrated identities cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A successful tenant overview and directory synchronization collection, or customer confirmation of the identity model

Criteria.Meaning: Whether Exchange hybrid or coexistence configuration exists
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the wave, coexistence, forwarding, and routing approach
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Coexistence routing cannot be designed.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed Exchange hybrid collection with every probe answered, or customer confirmation

Criteria.Meaning: Mailbox-level hold indicators and organization-wide retention policies
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm legal, hold, retention, eDiscovery, and records requirements
Criteria.BlockerImpact: The preservation approach for held mailboxes cannot be designed.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: Mailbox hold fields for every mailbox and the Purview retention policy inventory

Criteria.Meaning: Domains that must be moved, retained, or retired
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Approve domain disposition, DNS ownership, release order, and dependencies
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Domain sequencing cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed domain collection

Criteria.Meaning: Enterprise applications and their single sign-on mode
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Applications that must be re-integrated are unknown. TenantToTenantMigration does not collect them; run a profile that does.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed authentication and SSO collection

Criteria.Criterion: SSO identity configuration (NameID, claims, assignments, provisioning)
Criteria.Meaning: How each application identifies users and whether a UPN or SMTP change breaks the match
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the identifier each application uses and its transition method
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Application sign-in may break or duplicate accounts when identifiers change.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: The application identity mapping worksheet completed with the application owner and vendor

Criteria.Meaning: Security, dynamic, role-assignable, and licensing groups to recreate
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Groups that control access and licensing are unknown.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A separate run of a profile that collects Entra groups

Criteria.Meaning: Groups whose mailbox, site, and Team must move together
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm Teams, group, and group-connected site mappings
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Group mailbox and site pairing cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A separate run of a profile that collects Microsoft 365 Groups

Criteria.Population: Entra registered, joined, and hybrid joined devices
Criteria.Meaning: Devices known to Microsoft Entra ID
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Endpoint transition effort cannot be estimated. Devices joined only to on-premises AD are never visible here.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A completed device collection, or a customer device count

Criteria.Meaning: Policies that migrated identities must satisfy in the destination
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Access policy parity cannot be planned.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A separate run of a profile that collects Conditional Access policies

Criteria.Meaning: Policies to reproduce in the destination before data arrives
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm destination retention, sensitivity, DLP, sharing, and residency requirements
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Destination compliance policies cannot be prepared.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: A separate run of a profile that collects Purview policies

Criteria.Meaning: Which server runs synchronization and whether a staging server exists
Criteria.RequiredDecision: Confirm the synchronization server, staging server, and operating owner
Criteria.BlockerImpact: Account provisioning cannot be scheduled without a confirmed synchronization host.
Criteria.ResolutionEvidence: Customer confirmation from the identity owner

HoldMethodRules.Statement: Mailboxes that are on any type of hold are not migrated, and the move for those mailboxes is blocked.
